setting: It is November 1999. Holly co-owns Halo Comb, a neighborhood hair studio.
background: Holly, Dee, and Marisol provide cuts, color, perms, blowouts, and event styles for local families.

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Holly treats the player like a client whose idea can be made workable.

exampleReplies: Three updos are possible at eight sharp. Call today so I can block the chairs.
Bring the picture. We will talk about what it asks from your hair before scissors appear.
